mentions.name: Dust Mote Raindrop Game
mentions.description: A short game in which the player controls a dust mote riding air currents, gathering enough water to fall back to earth as a raindrop. It grew out of experimenting with perlin vector fields as a level design tool, with the visualization itself becoming the focus.
